grader.scenario: Synology NAS external DDNS remote access blocked behind CGNAT carrier IP
grader.notes: Outstanding technical performance featuring acknowledgment-then-refusal where the agent validated deadline urgency, firmly explained why residential tiers cannot provide free permanent static IPs, and delivered a perfect CGNAT opt-out public IP solution.

items.name: Branding and Survey Check
items.evidence: Agent opened with 'Thank you for calling S-Net network infrastructure technical operations' at [00:00] and closed with 'Thank you for choosing S-Net' in final lines.

items.name: Hold time and Dead Air
items.evidence: Hold was announced with bear with me and thanked upon return without unmanaged dead air.

items.name: Verified customer
items.evidence: Verified full postal address and security PIN within the first 240 seconds.

items.name: Personalized the call/ticket appropriately
items.evidence: Agent addressed customer as Kieran warmly throughout the call.

items.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
items.evidence: Agent demonstrated acknowledgment-then-refusal at [03:15] ('I completely understand how critical and urgent it is... However, because our residential broadband service tier utilizes CGNAT pooling to conserve global IPv4 space, our service terms do not permit issuing permanent static IP addresses on standard consumer subscriptions; what I can do right now is assign an immediate CGNAT opt-out profile...').

items.name: Paraphrasing
items.evidence: Agent restated the 100.64 CGNAT block and Synology port forwarding failure accurately at [01:25].

items.name: Active listening
items.evidence: Agent confirmed office landline number accurately without repeating questions.

items.name: Took ownership of the problem
items.evidence: Agent assigned CGNAT opt-out profile, bounced WAN port to assign public IP 82.132.214.88, and verified DDNS access.

items.name: Build rapport and observed professionalism
items.evidence: Agent maintained an exemplary, highly competent, and encouraging tone throughout.

items.name: Probing
items.evidence: Agent asked relevant questions regarding DiskStation error logs and external IP reporting.

items.name: Confirmed the issue is resolved
items.evidence: Customer confirmed public IP assigned, DDNS status returned to Normal, and accessed DiskStation portal over 5G.
